ValidationRule.description: Requires Machine Feature Detail when Out of Target Detail is Machine features.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Unqualified"), ISPICKVAL(Unqualified_Reason__c, "Out of target"), ISPICKVAL(Out_of_target_detail__c, "Machine features"), ISBLANK(Machine_feature_detail__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please specify the machine feature detail.
